version.description: Configuration file version (internal Cura schema version)

default_quality_name.description: Default quality profile name used when no printer is selected

locale.description: Language locale for UI and messages (e.g., 'en_US', 'de_DE')

enable_telemetry.description: Enable telemetry data collection (0=disabled, 1=enabled in config)

check_for_updates.description: Automatically check for software updates on startup

save_path.description: Default directory for saving exported G-code

plugins_path.description: Directory containing Cura plugins (e.g., community extensions)

has_heated_bed.description: Indicates whether the printer has a heated build plate

default_layer_height.description: Layer height in mm for standard prints (typical range: 0.05–0.3)

default_wall_thickness.description: Wall thickness in mm (must be divisible by nozzle diameter)

default_initial_layer_print_speed.description: Speed for the first layer to ensure bed adhesion (mm/s)

default_support_extruder.description: Extruder index to use for support structures (0=primary)

enable_support.description: Enable automatic support generation for overhangs

support_xy_distance.description: Horizontal gap between support and model (mm)

support_z_distance.description: Vertical gap between support and model (mm)

extruder_temps.description: List of per-extruder temperature settings (one entry per extruder)

minimum_fan_speed.description: Minimum cooling fan speed percentage (prevents stalling)

fan_speed_threshold_layer.description: Number of initial layers to ignore fan speed changes (for bed adhesion)

cooler_min_fan_speed.description: Fan speed to keep cooler operational during long prints (%

enable_cooling_fan.description: Enable fan control for cooling layers

fan_speed_at_height_50.description: Target fan speed at mid-print height (%)

extruder_temps[].initial_layer_bed_temp.description: Build plate temperature for first layer (°C)

extruder_temps[].retraction_distance.description: Retraction distance in mm (0 for direct drive, ~4–6 for bowden)

extruder_temps[].filament_diameter.description: Filament diameter in mm (1.75mm is standard)
